content:
The tallest building in the world is the **Burj Khalifa** in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It stands at **828 meters (2,717 feet)** tall with 163 floors above ground.

The Burj Khalifa has held this title since its completion in 2010. It's more than 200 meters taller than the second-tallest building.
